description: The insured vehicle, a 2019 black Toyota Rav4 (plate G-901234), was traveling on Expreso V Centenario when it collided with the rear of a 2018 Nissan Versa (plate H-345678) driven by Mr. Juan Peralta, who braked abruptly. The impact caused significant damage to the front of the insured vehicle, including a shattered and detached front bumper assembly, a cracked and broken grille, a dented and bent hood, cracked headlights with broken mounts, a punctured and bent radiator and support, and a minor dent with paint abrasion on the left front fender. No serious injuries were reported, but both drivers complained of minor neck stiffness. A police report (PN-SDQ-2026-011501) was filed. The estimated repair cost for the damages is DOP 198,000.
